class.name: VASourceAmbient
class.description: A non-spatialised ambient sound (e.g. rain, wind, room tone), muffled by the current [VAListener]'s ambient filter. It plays once the listener has its first ambient result, so give the listener [member VAEmitter.ambient_occlusion_ray_count] or [member VAEmitter.ambient_permeation_ray_count].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], this source is sent to the current [VAListener]'s reverb, muffled by the ambient filter. It then waits for the listener's first raytraced reverb before it plays, so it never starts in OpenAL's default reverb.
